title: Attack Lines Run Straight Then Cut (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 134bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl mandolin steel guitar
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, attack lines win the gain line
Run straight first, then cut at the last
Fix the defender, then beat them clean

[Verse 1]
The straight line is the threat, fix the defender
Ten metres of straight running, the sender
Then cut left or cut right at the last second
The defender is committed, the gap beckoned

[Pre-Chorus]
Angle of run thirty degrees off the gain line
Not too flat, not too round, the line
Hit the ball at full pace, never slow
Momentum carries through the contact, glow

[Chorus]
Attack lines run straight then cut, son
Fix the defender, the work begun
Thirty degrees off the gain line, hit at pace
Through the gap or through the face

[Verse 2]
Decoy runners draw defenders in
The real ball goes outside, the win
Miss pass cuts out the first receiver
Long skip pass to the wider deceiver

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, the gain line is the line where you tackled
Cross it forward, you win, son, never wrangled
Get across with momentum, get over the gain
Metres are points, son, metres are gain

[Chorus]
Attack lines run straight then cut, son
Fix the defender, the work begun
Thirty degrees off the gain line, hit at pace
Through the gap or through the face

[Outro]
Straight first, cut second
Fix the man, gap reckoned
Thirty degree angle, full pace
Thats my boy, win the race
